rows.label: qst500701_msg0001
rows.name: We had an Ardun calf born recently.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0002
rows.name: Take a look. Isn't it adorable?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0003
rows.name:
The only thing is, usually when
these beauties give birth, it's
to a bunch of calves at once...

rows.label: qst500701_msg0004
rows.name:
But for some reason this
one was an only child.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0005
rows.name:
That's why I feel I have to raise this
one with extra care.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0006
rows.name: Hey, you're Drivers, right?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0007
rows.name:
If you've got time to spare, would
you help me look after the calf?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0008
rows.name:
You don't have to do much. Just give
it some food every once in a while.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0009
rows.name:
I don't have any reward to offer,
but looking after an animal might
be a nice change from battle!

rows.label: qst500701_msg0010
rows.name:
Meeting all kinds of people should
help this one grow up big and strong.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0011
rows.name: Well, come round any time!

rows.label: qst500701_msg0101
rows.name:
Oh, have you brought some
food for the Ardun?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0102
rows.name:
It's still young, so there are limits
to what it can eat.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0103
rows.name:
You can't feed it just anything, but
go ahead and give it a few things.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0201
rows.name:
Oh, have you brought some
food for the Ardun?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0202
rows.name:
It's gotten bigger lately, hasn't it?
And it'll grow even bigger.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0301
rows.name:
Oh, have you brought some
food for the Ardun?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0302
rows.name:
Thanks to you, it's growing up well.
I'm sure the Ardun is grateful too.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0401
rows.name:
Oh, have you brought some
food for the Ardun?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0402
rows.name:
Thanks to you, it's fully grown now.
In fact, it's so strong I can barely
manage it.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0403
rows.name:
It has a huge appetite too. You should
give it some food yourselves.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0501
rows.name:
Oh, have you brought some
food for the Ardun?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0502
rows.name:
Thanks to you, it's on its way to
becoming the strongest Ardun in Gula.

rows.label: qst500701_msg0503
rows.name:
Now that we've come this far, maybe
I should give it a name...

rows.label: qst500701_msg0601
rows.name:
I've been watching Arduns for decades,
ever since I was born, but...

rows.label: qst500701_msg0602
rows.name:
I've never seen an Ardun look this
strong. It probably has enough food
now...

rows.label: qst500701_msg0603
rows.name:
So I came up with a name for this one.
Listen...

rows.label: qst500701_msg0604
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]Relentless Arduran!

rows.label: qst500701_msg0605
rows.name: [ML:Feeling ]What do you think? Cool, right?

rows.label: qst500701_msg0606
rows.name:
Feel free to spend some time with
Relentless Arduran if you like!

rows.label: qst500701_msg0607
rows.name:
Just try not to get too
carried away, okay?
